name: ABuildingProp_CreaturePlacer__HandleAsyncLoadVisualsComplete
inc_or_decl: Delegate target for UpdateCreatureVisuals. If the handle is missing, logs 'Failed to load assets for the selected creature visuals'. Otherwise gathers loaded objects, applies them (0x141c11f10), sets bCreatureVisualsDoneLoading = true, clears OnCreatureVisualsLoadComplete (0x1406a9dc0) and releases the handle. MEDIUM.
